mapper.select: select r.id, r.rank_type, r.rank_no, r.media_id, r.hot_score, r.snapshot_date, m.media_id as m_media_id, m.title as m_title, m.original_title as m_original_title, m.poster_path as m_poster_path, m.poster_local_url as m_poster_local_url, m.backdrop_path as m_backdrop_path, m.release_date as m_release_date, m.media_type as m_media_type, m.region as m_region, m.genres as m_genres, m.vote_average as m_vote_average, m.rating_avg as m_rating_avg, m.hot_score as m_hot_score from km_hot_rank r join km_media m on m.media_id = r.media_id where r.rank_type = #{rankType} and r.snapshot_date = (select max(snapshot_date) from km_hot_rank where rank_type = #{rankType}) order by r.rank_no asc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into km_hot_rank (rank_type, rank_no, media_id, hot_score, snapshot_date, create_time) values (#{rankType}, #{rankNo}, #{mediaId}, #{hotScore}, #{snapshotDate}, sysdate())
